QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] A Colorful Trade
QuestInfo.0: You return to the Land of Contemplation only to discover that the people who stole your color have returned to black-and-white. Go talk to them.
QuestInfo.1: The villagers say the rain washed away their color. You should try sharing yours.
QuestInfo.2: You shared your color with the people in the Land of Contemplation.
